g2_note: The mechanism a non-operator uses to close G2 now exists in the repo: a GitHub Actions workflow at .github/workflows/reproduce-fover-headline.yml that fresh-installs and asserts the published CIs, plus a Docker (or fresh-venv) clean-room recompute on a different base image than the operator's box. G2 is NOT closed by authoring this mechanism — closure requires an actual external/CI run by a non-operator reporting condition_A_auroc in [0.9027, 0.9235] and learning_contribution in [0.0125, 0.0245]. See ops/reproduction-runbook-fover-headline.md.
